faces.name: Hoarder's Greed
faces.oracleText: You lose 2 life and draw two cards, then clash with an opponent. If you win, repeat this process. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)

faces.name: Hoarder's Overflow
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters and whenever you expend 4, put a stash counter on it. (You expend 4 as you spend your fourth total mana to cast spells during a turn.)
{1}{R}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the number of stash counters on this enchantment.

faces.name: Hoard Hauler
faces.oracleText:
Trample
Whenever this Vehicle deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token for each artifact they control.
Crew 3

faces.name: Hoarding Broodlord
faces.oracleText:
Convoke
Flying
When this creature enters, search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle. For as long as that card remains exiled, you may play it.
Spells you cast from exile have convoke.

faces.name: Hoarding Dragon
faces.oracleText:
Flying
When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card, exile it, then shuffle.
When this creature dies, you may put the exiled card into its owner's hand.

faces.name: Hoarding Ogre
faces.oracleText:
Whenever this creature attacks, roll a d20.
1—9 | Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
10—19 | Create two Treasure tokens.
20 | Create three Treasure tokens.

faces.name: Hoarding Recluse
faces.oracleText:
Reach, deathtouch
When this creature dies, put up to one other target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.

faces.name: Hoard Robber
faces.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
